title: Formation of the anchored made field: place-dependent and uniform parts

key_results.statement: Every $L$, both graphs, $M\to\infty$ first, exact for the means: $\delta a(x,\lambda)=-[(1-\cos\sqrt{K_a}\lambda)K_a^{-1}]_{xx_s}$, $u=[\cos(\sqrt{K_a}\lambda)K_a^{-1}]_{xx_s}$, $\delta a_{\rm st}=-G_a(x,x_s)$; the state at $\lambda$ is $\Omega$ displaced by the means, so $w,\Gamma,\Sigma$ are static.
Laplace transform of the made field: $\widehat{\delta a}(x,s)=-R_{xx_s}(s)/s$ with the resolvent (5.9), every $L$, both graphs.

Image representation: $\delta a=\delta a_0(x-x_s,\lambda)+\int_0^\lambda S_0(x-h,\lambda-\lambda')\sigma_h(\lambda')d\lambda'$, with image strength $\sigma_h=-\kappa_a\delta a(h,\cdot)$ solving a Volterra equation, $\hat\sigma_h=\kappa_a\gamma_s(x_s-h)/\{s[1+\kappa_a\gamma_s(0)]\}$; static image strength 1.

Uniform part = place average $\bar U(\lambda)=-L^{-D}\int_0^\lambda(\lambda-\lambda')[1-\sigma_h(\lambda')]d\lambda'$ (net force of source and image); place-dependent part $\delta a^\perp=\delta a-\bar U$; every $L$, both graphs.
Static values of the two parts equal the uniform shift and the place-dependent part of (5.11): $\bar U_{\rm st}=-[1/\kappa_a+r(x_s,h)/2]$, $\delta a^\perp_{\rm st}=g(x-h)-g(x-x_s)$.
Laplace transform of the uniform part: $\hat{\bar U}(s)=-s^{-1}\{1+\kappa_a[\tilde\gamma_s(0)-\tilde\gamma_s(x_s-h)]\}/\{\kappa_a+L^Ds^2[1+\kappa_a\tilde\gamma_s(0)]\}$, every $L$, both graphs.

At every finite $L$, both graphs: the $\lambda$-mean of $\delta a$, $\bar U$, $\delta a^\perp$ is the static value, and $\delta a$ returns arbitrarily close to $0$ at arbitrarily large $\lambda$; so neither part meets (4.11), (4.19) or (9.1) for any $\varepsilon<1$ at fixed $L$.

Order $L\to\infty$ first, then $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w=c_0\lambda/\rho\neq1$: the free unpinned field forms at the front, $\rho\,\delta a_0\to-\theta(w-1)/(4\pi\kappa_h)$ ($D=3$), $\nabla\delta a_0\to\theta(w-1)/(2\kappa_h)$ ($D=1$); front speed = largest slope of the normal-mode frequency = $c_0$.

Order $L\to\infty$ first, $d_s\to\infty$ on the scale $\lambda\propto d_s$: $\sigma_h\to\beta\,\theta(c_0\lambda-d_s)$ with $\beta=g_\infty(x_s-h)/c_\phi$ ($D=3$) and $\beta=1$ ($D=1$); in this order the uniform part and, for $D=3$, an image of strength $1-\beta$ never form.

Cubic torus, order $L\to\infty$, then $\rho\to\infty$ along an axis at fixed $w$, $a=d_s/\rho$, $b=d_x/\rho\neq1$: $\Delta_3^\perp\to-1$ ($w<1$), $1/(b-1)$ ($w>1$); $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to1$ if $b>1+1/\varepsilon$ (formation speed $c_0$, independent of $\kappa_a$; every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ once $b\to\infty$), no formation if $|b-1|<1/\varepsilon$.

Cubic torus, order $L\to\infty$, then $\ell\to\infty$ at fixed $w$ and $a=d_s/\ell>2$: the shell criterion (4.19) for $\delta a^\perp$ holds from $c_0\lambda=w_\varepsilon\ell$ on, $w_\varepsilon\in[1,2]$, iff $\theta_a\le\varepsilon/(1+\varepsilon)$; formation in the mean by $c_0\lambda\le2\ell$ as $a\to\infty$, never for $a<(1+\varepsilon)/\varepsilon$.

Ring (control), order $L\to\infty$, then $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w$ and $a=d_s/\rho>1$, observation between source and anchor: $\Delta_1\to-1,-1/2,0$ on $w<1$, $1<w<2a-1$, $w>2a-1$; for $\varepsilon<1/2$, $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to2a-1$, so with the anchor far ($a\to\infty$) no formation within any $\lambda$ linear in $\rho$; for $\varepsilon>1/2$ the limit is 1.

Cubic torus as $L\to\infty$, uniformly in $\lambda\ge0$: $\bar U=\bar U_{\rm st}[1-\cos(\lambda/T_U)]+O(L^{-1})|\bar U_{\rm st}|$, $T_U=\sqrt{L^3c_\phi^{(L)}}[1+O(L^{-2})]$ (depends on $\kappa_a$ via $c_\phi$, not on $d_s$); slow mode carries the oscillating image $-(1-\beta_L)g(x-h)$; same form on the ring for $\kappa_aL\ll\kappa_h$ with $T_U\simeq(L/\kappa_a)^{1/2}$.

Ring, $L\to\infty$ at fixed $c_0\lambda/L$ and $d_s/L$ ($\kappa_aL\gg\kappa_h$): $\bar U=-(L/2\kappa_h)[f(\alpha)-f(\alpha+\tau)/2-f(\alpha-\tau)/2]+O(L^0)$, a string fixed at the anchor, periodic with period $2L/c_0$ between $0$ and $2\bar U_{\rm st}$; with (9.8)-(9.10) the uniform part reaches its static value in no order of the limits, only as a $\lambda$-mean.

Cubic torus, order $L\to\infty$, then $d/\ell\to\infty$, then $\ell\to\infty$ at fixed $w$: the long-range mark (5.15)(a), formation of the place-dependent part within a $\lambda$ linear in the distance at speed $c_0$, and the weighing of 05-anchor (within (A), or (B) with $R/d\to0$) hold together at leading order in $\ell/d$; no such order with $d$ comparable to $\ell$, nor with $\lambda$ growing with $L$.

definitions.name: uniform part of the made field
place-dependent part of the made field
share of the source force taken by the anchor on the infinite lattice
uniform time scale of the anchored cubic torus
orders of limits O1 (L first) and O2 (lambda growing with L)

open_issues: Lattice corrections in (9.11), (9.13) near the fronts and the O(ρ^{1/3}) delay rest on stationary phase with fold caustics assumed at m_h = 0; the code shows wakes of 0.30 to 0.16 decaying about as ρ^{-0.4} at ρ ≤ 16, which delay formation at ε ≲ 0.3.
The error terms of (9.14) are upper bounds; the code finds much smaller deviations.
In order O2 on the cubic torus the non-slow modes beyond the wrap time are controlled only by (9.8); no criterion restricted to a window of λ is studied.
Item 4 uses the weighing of 05-anchor as quoted in words; the carry-over assumes it rests only on place differences of φ_a and on w, Γ, Σ.
The ring with κ_a L comparable to κ_h is not treated; (9.14) and (9.15) are its two limits.

consistency_checks.check: Far from the anchor (9.11) reduces to (4.12) at μ = 0 and to the μ → 0 limit of (4.13)
Limit κ_a → ∞: finite T_U, β < 1, exact fixed point on the ring, (9.6) reduces to (5.11) at 1/κ_a = 0
